intro: The State of the Mines is a task given by Alba Fairmoon to combat environmental contamination across Westfall. Toxic runoff from the region's seized dig sites threatens to ruin the farmland for decades. To stop this ecological disaster, adventurers are sent to disrupt Defias-led excavations at both Jangolode Mine and the Gold Coast Quarry.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.

The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
